findings.title: Android FrameTimeline unavailable across triad
findings.claim: queryFrameTimeline reports androidFrameTimeline.available=false for base/cur/throttle; choreographer summary may exist but Android jank/GPU busy cannot be classified from this sample set.
findings.boundary: FrameTimeline unavailable; no jank finding synthesized

findings.title: base callTree available via PlayerLoop anchor fallback
findings.claim: base getPerfettoCallTree returns available=true with PlayerLoop on hotPath, but WT-014 parseNotes show root aggregation was empty and tree was built via PlayerLoop anchor fallback — treat absolute ms as lower-confidence vs cur/throttle native roots.

findings.title: throttle CPU freq decline co-directional with UnityMain sched shift (window)
findings.claim: cur avgMhz=1576.3 → throttle avgMhz=1324.6 (down=true); UnityMain runningPct 77.82 → 56.99 (down=true); sleepingPct 20.4 → 38.99 (up=true); throttle throttlingLevel=suspected suspected=true. Co-direction is window-level only (correlateFrameSchedCpu granularity=window).

findings.title: cur vs throttle atrace slice deltas (PlayerLoop / BehaviourUpdate / FinishFrameRendering)
findings.claim: PlayerLoop: cur(count=484,avgMs=30.183) vs throttle(count=428,avgMs=46.567); BehaviourUpdate: cur(count=484,avgMs=7.905) vs throttle(count=428,avgMs=8.804); FinishFrameRendering(hotPath): cur(totalMs=6311.62,totalPct=43.03) vs throttle(totalMs=11117.55,totalPct=55.71)
findings.boundary: atrace aggregates + callTree hotPath; not frame-timeline jank

findings.title: correlateFrameSchedCpu is window-granularity only
findings.claim: correlateFrameSchedCpu on cur/throttle reports granularity=window; must not claim per-frame frame↔sched↔cpu correlation.

findings.title: base vs cur UnityMain sched snapshot
findings.claim: UnityMain runningPct base=86.94 cur=77.82; sleepingPct base=12.04 cur=20.4
findings.boundary: window sched aggregates; not FrameTimeline jank
